notes.title: Fire Up! Scorched Sky Celebrations Return!
notes.content:
[b]Scorched Sky Celebrations Are Back![/b]
 
The pyres of the Scorched Sky Celebration have been ignited once more, and worshipers of Fennin Ro and his son, Solusek Ro, can be found celebrating their gods across all of Norrath!
 
During this special celebration, the devotees of Flame are offering a chance for all to rejoice in the primal power of Fire and Flame, with no grudge towards those who have embraced other deities. They believe that within the flames all mettle is tempered, both literally and figuratively. That which is weak, distracting, and fleeting will be burned away in battles against fire elementals, leaving only the strong, pure, and resilient.
 
From [b]Wednesday, June 26, 2019 at 12:01 AM PT[/b] until [b]Monday, July 8, 2019 at 11:59 PM PT[/b], you'll be able to join the devotees of Flame for this fiery celebration.
 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3953123/072c98553415b7df40a2553d5ff4666a2d5e2001.jpg[/img]
 
If you're looking to learn a bit more about what's in store before facing the inferno, read on for details about the celebration's unique events and rewards!
 
[b]Where to Celebrate:[/b]
 
You can partake in the fiery festivities by finding a fire worshiper in one of the following areas:
[list]
[*]Antonica[/*]
[*]The Commonlands[/*]
[*]Darklight Wood[/*]
[*]Lavastorm[/*]
[*]The Pillars of Flame[/*]
[*]The Sinking Sands[/*]
[*]Butcherblock Mountains[/*]
[*]Great Divide[/*]
[*]Tranquil Sea[/*]
[/list]
 
[b]Quests:[/b]
 
Lend a hand in kick-starting the celebrations or help care for cold-bloodded creatures attracted to the flames in the following quests:
[list]
[*]Festive Fireworks - Speak with a Fireworks Coordinator in any player city.[/*]
[*]The Heat Is On - Speak with Limora Roamhill in Darklight Wood.[/*]
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3953123/8b73648e84979f9bfc53b90f78d773f204382c89.jpg[/img]
 
[b]Achievements:[/b]
 
Face the fire elementals to become tempered by the flames and earn a title!
[list]
[*]The Scorched[/*]
[/list]
 
[b]Collections:[/b]
 
Complete this event collection and you'll be handsomely rewarded!
[list]
[*]Corilac Gems[/*]
[/list]
 
[b]Buyables:[/b]
 
There are a number of new, red hot items that you'll be able to purchase during the celebration including:
[list]
[*]Frock of Flame Armor Crate[/*]
[*]Cracked Lava building blocks[/*]
[*]Petamorph Wand: Ravenous Hellhound[/*]
[*]Fire-themed house decorations[/*]
[*]A variety of hot plushies[/*]
[*]And more to get you fired up![/*]
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3953123/9001f54854f9e9689cadd580047b40740d94d93b.jpg[/img]
 
[b]TLE Servers:[/b]
 
No participation on Kaladim.
 
 
Want to learn more about the events and rewards available this Scorched Sky? Take a look at some of the helpful guides available from these fiery Fansites:
[list]
[*][url=http://eq2.eqtraders.com/articles/article_page.php?article=q435&menustr=080000000000]EQ2 Traders Corner[/url][/*]
[*][url=http://eq2furniture.com/index.php?item=&category=&subcategory=&type=&event=Scorched+Sky+Celebration&tier=&recipebook=&ingredient=&quest=&starter=&zone=&merchant=&faction=&mob=&awarded=&claimed=&currency=&lon=&creator=&housetype=&placement=&description=&date1=&date2=]EQ2 Furniture[/url][/*]
[/list]
 
The celebrations are all ablaze, so head on out and enjoy the Scorched Sky before the festivities end on July 8, 2019!

notes.title: Producer's Letter: Summer 2019
notes.content:
[b]Hail, almighty Norrathans![/b]

Summer is upon us and we've got updates for you! We are all really excited for what's coming this year, including the 15th Anniversary of EverQuest II and our expansion. And we've got plenty coming up between now and then!


[b]Legendary Ethereal Item Drops and New Expert Dungeons![/b]

This summer, play in new Expert versions of the heroic dungeons in the Chaos Descending expansion for awesome lewtz! It’s a good idea to use this opportunity to get leveled up for...reasons…too!

Check out this Fabled item from an Expert dungeon:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3953123/eff887110e9f3089b73e28bee0f8df09bfe8fa2e.jpg[/img]

You also may want to look for some best-in-slot items in the Chaos Descending Public Quests as of the June 18th Game Update too. Vagueness intended. Both the Chaos Descending Public Quests and Expert Dungeons begin June 18, 2019. 

Here's a look at a couple of the tasty Ethereal armor items dropping this summer.  Whoa.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3953123/63cdefd57f08fc8fc74d872742bbec0e8c0159e9.jpg[/img]


[b]Nagafen PVP Server Seasons[/b]

The first Nagafen PVP Server Season 1 will come to an end on June 18, 2019, with the Game Update and will kick off its Season 2 on July 16, 2019. The team will be making some changes and tweaks based on Season 1, so keep an eye out from posts from the team as we move along!


[b]Let’s Celebrate Pride![/b]

This year, you can get our Pride-themed bunny familiars from the in-game store for free from June 21, 2019, until July 31, 2019. As a studio, we support every gamer who contributes to our community. Show the love!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3953123/b14c5a9e026a6c0e59cab5671129b25a7fe75979.png[/img]


[b]The Scorched Sky Celebration Heats Up![/b]

For the second time, worshipers of Fennin Ro and his son, Solusek Ro, will be celebrating across Norrath with Scorched Sky celebrations! The celebrations begin June 26, 2019, and end July 8, 2019. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3953123/072c98553415b7df40a2553d5ff4666a2d5e2001.jpg[/img]

What's new with Scorched Sky this year?

The Ember merchants have 31 new items available, including a whole new building block set and an armor crate!
New Quest: The Heat Is On offered by Limora Roamhill in Darklight Wood.

Returning Features:

[list]
[*] In-game mail to announce the event.
[*] Ro worshipers are found fire dancing, summoning fire elementals and praising Fennin and Solusek Ro.
[*] Tempered by Flame - Players defeat fire elementals (level scaling) found in areas of the world where followers of Ro are located. Defeat fire elementals to earn Coin of Ember.
[*] New "Corilac Gem Stones" event collection.
[*] "Festive Fireworks" city quests.
[/list]

During this special celebration, the devotees of Flame are offering a chance for all to rejoice in the primal power of Fire and Flame, with no grudge towards those who have embraced other deities. They believe that within the flames all mettle is tempered, both literally and figuratively. That which is weak, distracting, and fleeting will be burned away in battles against fire elementals, leaving only the strong and resilient.

For a full breakdown of the event locations, merchant items, lore and more, see this post from the celebration’s introduction last year: [url=https://www.everquest2.com/news/eq2-scorched-sky-celebration-june-2018]https://www.everquest2.com/news/eq2-scorched-sky-celebration-june-2018[/url].


[b]Expansion Tidbits. Like, Itty Bitty Bits[/b]

It’s definitely a little early to be talking about the expansion, but we can tell you it’s a good idea to level up your characters over summer and fall with our leveling-up events!

Yep, we are doing a 10-level increase this year with our expansion. We also have some new features we're excited to talk about when we get into the nitty gritty of the expansion this fall, including the lore and location...and it's a familiar one if you know EQ.

Nope, no more on that. Guess all you like. You might get lucky.
 

[b]EverQuest Anniversary Pack Countdown[/b]

Don't forget to get your hands on the EverQuest Anniversary Pack available on the store. It's got some goodies you might be interested in! The regular price is $34.99 (for a $60 value) but you can get it for $19.99 from now and throughout June. It's got a Flame-Branded Steed mount, Journeyman Boots of Adventure, a backpack, painting, mount Barding Slot unlocker, and more! To see all the details, go to: [url=https://www.everquest2.com/news/eq2-year-of-everquest-pack-updated-2019]https://www.everquest2.com/news/eq2-year-of-everquest-pack-updated-2019[/url].

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3953123/6cafb66bd1773f247b654295d2194c50bac8d0d2.jpg[/img]
 

[b]Getting Together[/b]

We are still working on planning a fan event (now probably next year to give EverQuest and EverQuest II fans and guilds time to prepare and plan). We’ll have some questions to ask the community about who might be interested in joining us for a weekend fan event, focused on the them, with Q&As, roundtables, and activities for gamers and roleplayers. Fun stuff!

We’ll start rolling out some questions and surveys as we move forward!


Sincerely, as always, friends,
Holly “Windstalker” Longdale
